# defectdojo_announcement (Resource)

Manages DefectDojo's announcement: a banner on every page for every user. DefectDojo keeps at most one announcement, and it always has the ID 1. Managing it needs a superuser: `change_announcement` is the only configuration permission for it, and reading, creating and deleting it need more.

A change of `message` or `style` replaces the announcement, as DefectDojo's UI does, so that every user sees the new one, including users who dismissed the old one. `create_before_destroy` can't work, since DefectDojo keeps only one announcement. Creating the resource fails when an announcement exists; import it with the ID 1 instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "defectdojo_announcement" "maintenance" {
  message     = "DefectDojo is down for maintenance on Saturday from 08:00 to 10:00 UTC. <a href=\"https://status.example.com\">Status page</a>"
  style       = "warning"
  dismissable = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `message` (String) The text of the banner, at most 500 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. It may contain basic HTML, such as links. Changing it replaces the announcement, so every user sees it again.

### Optional

- `dismissable` (Boolean) Whether users can dismiss the banner. Defaults to `false`. Changing it doesn't replace the announcement, so turning it off doesn't show the banner again to users who dismissed it; change the message to replace it. A dismissal doesn't last either: DefectDojo shows the banner again to a user whenever their user record is saved.
- `style` (String) The style of the banner: one of `info`, `success`, `warning` and `danger`. Defaults to `info`. Changing it replaces the announcement, so every user sees it again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the announcement, always 1.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_announcement.example
  identity = {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the announcement

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The announcement always has the ID 1
terraform import defectdojo_announcement.example 1
```
